name: Reference Part Segmentation
author: Modly
description: Produces topology-bound geometric part regions from imported or generated meshes. The pinned GeoSAM2 all-view adapter is the default; P3-SAM remains selectable for legacy workflow compatibility.

params_schema.label: Segmentation Adapter
params_schema.tooltip: GeoSAM2 is the default pinned all-view native-3D adapter. P3-SAM remains available for existing workflows; its current target quality screen does not meet the audited acceptance threshold.

params_schema.label: Sampled Surface Points
params_schema.tooltip: Controls the legacy P3-SAM surface sampling path; unused by GeoSAM2.

params_schema.label: Point Prompts
params_schema.tooltip: Controls point prompts for the legacy P3-SAM path; unused by GeoSAM2.

params_schema.label: Prompt Batch Size
params_schema.tooltip: Controls prompt execution chunking for legacy P3-SAM; unused by GeoSAM2.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Seed for the selected adapter. The current GeoSAM2 all-view path requires its frozen seed of 42.
